pages.text: One sunny morning, <name> wandered through the forest and discovered a bridge made entirely of sparkling crystal, stretching over a shimmering river. The bridge glowed in rainbow colors, reflecting sunlight like a thousand tiny diamonds.
As he stepped closer, a tiny, grumpy troll appeared, crossing his arms and scowling.
“Who dares to cross my bridge?” the troll grumbled. “Only kind-hearted adventurers may pass!”
<name> thought quickly. “I am kind!” he said politely. “But how can I prove it?”
The troll scratched his head. “Answer this riddle: ‘I shine for others without a single cheer; what am I?’”

<name> paused. He looked around and noticed the flowers along the riverbank glowing softly, lighting up the path for animals in the shade. Smiling, he said, “A lantern! It shines for everyone without asking for thanks.”
The troll’s frown softened. “Clever and thoughtful,” he chuckled, stepping aside. “You may cross — but gently!”

<name> tiptoed carefully across the crystal bridge, marveling at the way it sparkled beneath his feet. Tiny fairies danced in the air, and mischievous pixies peeked from behind rainbow-colored stones. He felt like he was walking on light itself.

At the other end, he discovered a hidden meadow filled with glowing flowers, their soft light flickering like stars. Butterflies with shimmering wings fluttered lazily, and a gentle stream sang a sparkling tune. <name> ran through the meadow, his heart light with wonder.
He realized that empathy, clever thinking, and courage open doors to magical places, and that sometimes the smallest act of kindness can win over even the grumpiest guardian.
From that day on, <name> remembered the troll and the crystal bridge whenever he faced a challenge — knowing that bravery and a warm heart could lead to the most wondrous adventures.
